output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function increases the balance of a user without a check, allowing attackers to mint arbitrary amounts of tokens.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction of the amount from the sender's balance causes an underflow, allowing attackers to transfer arbitrary amounts of tokens.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the addition of the amount to the spender's allowance causes an overflow, allowing attackers to approve arbitrary amounts.
